hints.title: Map 2D Coordinates to 1D Indices
hints.text: Cell (r, c) maps to a flat index r * n + c within total elements m * n.

hints.title: Apply Circular Shift Modulo Total Elements
hints.text: Shifting by k positions places flat index i at new flat index (i + k) % (m * n).

hints.title: Convert Back to 2D Coordinates
hints.text: The new row is new_index // n and new column is new_index % n in the output grid.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating k shifts step by step takes O(k * M * N) time, which is slow for large k.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Direct index translation with modulo arithmetic computes the result in single-pass O(M * N) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should map between 1D and 2D index spaces smoothly using division and modulo.
complexity.notes: k modulo total elements simplifies shift operations.
